tools.name: create_org_chart
tools.description: Create an org chart from a list of people and get a link that opens it in the SimplOrg editor. Up to 500 people. The link stays valid for 30 days; after opening it the user can save or share the chart from SimplOrg.

tools.name: read_org_chart
tools.description: Read the people and reporting lines from a SimplOrg chart link (an AI-created link or a share link). Use it to update an existing chart: edit the returned list and pass it to create_org_chart.
